title: Decompose the bounded legacy engine:F1-F10 backlog into positive capability work
description:
Decompose the legacy magic-item executionReadiness engine:F1-F10 backlog into implementable
positive capability operations. The legacy artifact defines only the backlog being migrated,
not all mechanics required by the source. Each child capability states operation/inputs/
exclusions/revision/residual interpretation and does not inherit whole-clause/record completeness.
acceptance_criteria:
- Each engine:F family has an explicit bounded backlog membership query over the legacy executionReadiness population.
- Decomposition produces positive capability operations rather than implement-every-mechanic obligations.
- Shared primitives are justified by concrete selected operations.
- Empty/unclassified results cannot be interpreted as source absence.
- Decomposition does not gate SRD re-freeze on completing the entire backlog.
